issues.detail: The Greek 'ενιαυτον' (enianton) means 'for a year', but the Vietnamese translation 'trong suốt một năm' (during/throughout one year) combined with the structure 'Xảy ra trong suốt một năm' implies it happened *within* a year or *during* a year, whereas the Greek denotes a duration of one year.
The Greek 'ικανον χρηματισαι' (ikanon chrimatisei) means 'capable of earning/making a living'. The Vietnamese translation completely omits this concept, missing the specific purpose of the teaching.
